au_w_0001.q: What is synthetic weed (Spice, K2) like, and is it riskier than real cannabis?
au_w_0001.short: Yes, synthetic weed can feel like cannabis but can be stronger or more unpleasant. Some types can have more dangerous effects than real cannabis.
au_w_0001.but: The full health risks are not yet fully understood because there are many different compounds.
how: FRANK says effects can be similar to cannabis but can also be stronger or more unpleasant.
FRANK says they are often more potent than natural cannabis, making it easier to use too much.
Australia's Alcohol and Drug Foundation says they can be stronger, more dangerous, and cause unpredictable effects.
Australia's Alcohol and Drug Foundation says they can produce very different effects to cannabis.

howq.q: Effects can be similar to cannabis but can also be stronger or more unpleasant
However, synthetic and semi-synthetic cannabinoids are often more potent than natural cannabis
They can be stronger, more dangerous and cause unpredictable effects
produce very different effects to cannabis (THC) (delta-9 tetrahydrocannabinol), the active ingredient in cannabis

au_w_0032.q: Why does coffee make some people anxious and jittery but not others?
au_w_0032.short: It depends on size, weight, health, and tolerance. People differ in how they metabolize caffeine.
au_w_0032.but: The degree to which tolerance to caffeine’s effects develops is unclear.
how: Australia's Alcohol and Drug Foundation says caffeine affects people differently based on size, weight, and health.

howq.q: Caffeine can affect everyone differently, based on: size, weight and health
